_doc: What a character was before the road. Authored as a free-standing pool with no character in mind, then cast (see data/casting.json and docs/14-lore-pools.md). Entries marked provisional were migrated out of Character.BACKGROUNDS and exist so the game runs while the real pool is written; replace them, do not extend them.

_schema.display_name: Short name shown on the reveal screen.
_schema.blurb: One line. What it makes of a person.
_schema.text: The authored history, a short paragraph.
_schema.tags: Shared vocabulary across every pool; drives casting suggestions.
_schema.gift: One gift, kind out of: doctrine | item | gold | grudge | hearth | bond | stat.

apprentice_smith.blurb: Raised at a village forge, and still has the arms for it. The village is gone.
apprentice_smith.text: Put to the forge young, kept there by a master who taught by silence and correction. The work was honest and the town was small, and both were gone inside an afternoon.

exiled_noble.blurb: Born to a house that has lost its hall. Still sits at the head of any table.
exiled_noble.text: Born to a name that opened doors, and kept the name after the doors were shut. Walks like the hall is still standing, because somebody has to.

cloistered_scholar.blurb: Taught among cold stone and copied pages. Reads whatever is left lying about, and keeps it.
cloistered_scholar.text: Years of copied pages and cold stone, learning that knowledge fades unless it is used. Left when the war came close enough to hear from the scriptorium.

wilderness_stray.blurb: Grew up in the woods, under no town's law. Knows which water is safe to drink.
wilderness_stray.text: No village raised them and no bell marked their days. They learned weather, track and water the way other children learn a trade.

outcast_drifter.blurb: Turned away at every door, and sleeps where nobody else will.
outcast_drifter.text: Turned out of somewhere for something, and has stopped correcting the story. Sleeps closer to the gates than anyone sensible would.
